circulating throughout your entire physical body.

Feel your blood flowing smoothly and evenly, reaching every
part of you with the oxygen and nourishment it needs.

Become aware of the arteries, veins, and tiny blood vessels
that carry this flow throughout your body.

See and feel each vessel becoming stronger, healthier,
and more flexible, maintaining its ideal shape and size
for smooth and natural circulation.

Imagine every restriction clearing, and see the pathways
of circulation becoming open and free.

See your entire circulation system working smoothly,
evenly, and efficiently.

Now bring your awareness to the nourishment carried
by your blood.

With every breath, your lungs supply the oxygen your
body needs, and your digestive system provides the
nutrients that sustain your strength and vitality.

Your blood carries this oxygen and nourishment throughout
your body, delivering it where it is needed.

Feel the energy and vitality of this nourishment
reaching every part of you.

Your lungs, kidneys, liver, and other organs work
together to process and eliminate waste and to
maintain your body's natural balance.

Your body's protective and maintenance systems work
together in complete harmony, each doing exactly
what is needed.

Now know that this pattern of smooth circulation,
nourishment, and maintenance is firmly established
within you.

From this moment forward, your body will maintain
this healthy pattern automatically, without conscious
thought or effort.

Whether you are awake, resting, or sleeping, your
natural circulation and maintenance systems will
continue working for you.

Blood flow will adjust smoothly and appropriately
to the needs of each part of your body, supplying
more where needed and maintaining balance throughout.

This automatic process will remain naturally regulated,
providing exactly what your body needs without
unnecessary strain or excess.

The pattern is lasting and continuous, becoming a
natural part of your everyday life.

With each passing day, your circulation will become
smoother, more balanced, and more efficient.

You will feel stronger, refreshed, and full of
natural vitality.

Whenever you wish to give this established pattern
additional attention and reinforcement, you can
do so quickly and easily.

Simply close your eyes and bring your awareness
to the area you wish to improve.

Take a deep breath in and gently hold it.

While holding your breath, silently say to yourself,
"Plus Circulate."

Then slowly exhale through your mouth, as though
gently blowing out a candle.

As you exhale, visualize smooth, balanced circulation
throughout your chosen area.

Your mind will reinforce this already-established
pattern of healthy circulation and maintenance.

Each time you use Plus Circulate, conscious
reinforcement of this pattern becomes easier,
faster, and more effective.

Remember, your body's natural circulation and
maintenance will continue automatically, whether
or not you think about it.

Plus Circulate is always available whenever
you choose to focus and reinforce this pattern.

Your blood will flow smoothly and evenly,
bringing nourishment and vitality throughout
your body.

From this moment forward, you will have greater
control over your appetite and your desire for food.

You will recognize the difference between your body's
genuine need for nourishment and the passing desire
to eat out of habit, boredom, or impulse.

Your mind and body will work together in harmony,
helping you make clear, confident decisions
about when and what you choose to eat.

When your body needs nourishment, you will recognize
that need clearly and respond appropriately.

When a temporary craving arises and you consciously
choose not to eat, you will remain calm,
comfortable, and in complete control of your decision.

From this moment forward, this awareness
will become a natural and automatic part
of your everyday life.

You will find it easier to recognize when you
have eaten enough, to enjoy the food you choose,
and to stop eating when you are comfortably satisfied.

Your choices will become clearer,
your habits more intentional,
and your confidence stronger.

Whenever you wish to release a passing craving
or an unnecessary desire for food,
you can do so quickly and easily.

Simply pause and bring your awareness
to the desire you wish to release.

Take a comfortable breath in
and gently hold it.

While holding your breath, silently
say to yourself, "Plus Satisfied."

Then slowly exhale through your mouth,
as though gently blowing out a candle.

As you exhale, the unnecessary desire to eat
will become less and less important to you.

Your thoughts will become calm and clear.

You will feel satisfied with your decision
and free to direct your attention
toward whatever you choose.

Food will no longer demand your attention
simply because it is present,
because you see it, or because you smell it.

You will remain free to enjoy food
when you consciously choose to eat.

Your body will continue to communicate
its genuine needs clearly and naturally.

You will respond to those needs with confidence,
maintaining the nourishment and balance
your body requires.

Now know that this pattern of conscious choice
is becoming firmly established within you.

From this moment forward, your ability
to recognize unnecessary cravings
and release them will operate automatically.

Your mind will naturally pause before
habitual or impulsive eating,
allowing you to make a clear decision.

You will feel comfortable and confident
choosing when to eat and when to wait.

Each time you use Plus Satisfied,
your ability to release unnecessary cravings
becomes easier, smoother, and more effective.

Remember, your appetite is something
you can understand and consciously direct.

You will recognize your body's needs,
make your decisions clearly,
and remain in control of your choices.

This lasting pattern of awareness,
satisfaction, and self-control
will continue strengthening every day.

Beginning now, and from this moment forward,
your mind, nervous system, and muscles
will work together in ever greater harmony.

will travel smoothly, evenly, and rapidly.

producing the movement you intend
at exactly the time it is needed.

grace, accuracy, and natural ease.

without unnecessary hesitation, tension, or effort.

movement, and timing will become clearer.

as though gently blowing out a candle.

come into clearer, smoother coordination,
responding with effortless speed and control.

this natural harmony of mind and body
will become easier, stronger, and more effective.
